hook: What Trump, Xi and Putin just agreed
reel_hook: Trump, Xi and Putin, in one room

slides.title: First US-China-Russia summit
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round lacquered table in a Chinese villa garden, an olive branch resting on a closed blank folder, soft evening light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Trump, Xi and Putin held their first three-way summit.
WHY IT MATTERS
They adopted a four-point 'declaration of peace'.
FOR YOU
It covers UN reform, oil supply and nuclear risk; Ukraine was largely sidestepped.
slides.body: Trump, Xi and Putin held their first three-way summit. They adopted a four-point 'declaration of peace'. It covers UN reform, oil supply and nuclear risk; Ukraine was largely sidestepped.

slides.title: Iran widens Gulf attacks
slides.image_prompt: Air defence radar dish on a desert base at dusk, a small drone silhouette against an orange sky over the Gulf
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran targeted a Kuwait air base and sites in Bahrain.
WHY IT MATTERS
It followed a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island.
FOR YOU
Americans in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain got renewed US security warnings.
slides.body: Iran targeted a Kuwait air base and sites in Bahrain. It followed a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island. Americans in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain got renewed US security warnings.

slides.title: Israeli tanks raid central Gaza
slides.image_prompt: Fresh tank tracks in sand beside a dusty empty road, abandoned tents in the hazy distance, pale morning sky
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Israel launched its first major Gaza raid since the ceasefire.
WHY IT MATTERS
Hamas calls it a flagrant ceasefire violation.
FOR YOU
Israel ended the raid Thursday and reopened Gaza's main Salah al-Din road.
slides.body: Israel launched its first major Gaza raid since the ceasefire. Hamas calls it a flagrant ceasefire violation. Israel ended the raid Thursday and reopened Gaza's main Salah al-Din road.

slides.title: Crimean Bridge hit again
slides.image_prompt: Long road and rail bridge over a calm strait at dawn, a gap in the road section, thin smoke drifting over the water
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge for a third time this week.
WHY IT MATTERS
It links Russia to Crimea, annexed by Russia in 2014.
FOR YOU
Rail traffic was halted; road traffic has been impossible since Tuesday's strike.
slides.body: Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge for a third time this week. It links Russia to Crimea, annexed by Russia in 2014. Rail traffic was halted; road traffic has been impossible since Tuesday's strike.

slides.title: Peru frees rescued pelicans
slides.image_prompt: Pelicans taking flight over a coastal wetland at sunrise, Pacific waves and reeds in the background
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Peru released rescued pelicans after a month of care.
WHY IT MATTERS
It opened Peru's first state marine wildlife centre.
FOR YOU
The centre can care for about 100 animals at once, including Humboldt penguins.
slides.body: Peru released rescued pelicans after a month of care. It opened Peru's first state marine wildlife centre. The centre can care for about 100 animals at once, including Humboldt penguins.

caption:
🤝 Trump, Xi and Putin held their first three-way summit in Shenzhen and adopted a four-point peace declaration.
⚠️ Iran widened attacks to Kuwait and Bahrain after a US strike on Qeshm Island. Americans in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain: check the latest State Department warnings.
🪖 Israel's first major Gaza ground raid since the ceasefire ended after one day.
🌉 Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge for the third time this week.
🐦 Peru freed rescued pelicans as its first state marine wildlife centre opened.
Can a three-way summit actually change anything? Tell us below 👇
